info.title: Universal Fabric Vendor Status
info.description: Read-only access to the Salesforce-mirrored vendor sync state in Dataverse. Used by the Copilot Studio vendor-Q&A agent to answer questions like 'what is the sync status of vendor X?' or 'which vendors failed to sync?'

scopes.user_impersonation: Have full access to the Dataverse environment on behalf of the signed-in user.

get.summary: Get vendor sync status by Salesforce ID
get.description: Returns the current sync state of a single vendor Account identified by its Salesforce record ID (alternate key lookup via crfe6_salesforceid). The crfe6_syncstatus field is stamped by the Azure Function on every successful sync attempt.

parameters.name: salesforceId
parameters.description: The 18-character Salesforce Account ID (e.g. 001D000000I8aWY). This is the alternate key used to upsert the vendor row in Dataverse.

200.description: The vendor was found. The body contains the sync-relevant projection of the Account row.

404.description: No Account row exists with the given crfe6_salesforceid alternate key. The vendor has never been synced to Dataverse.

fallbackResponse.description: Returns a NotSynced payload when the underlying call returns 404, so the agent can phrase a friendly answer instead of surfacing the raw HTTP error.

get.description: Returns Account rows filtered by crfe6_syncstatus (Pending / Synced / Error). Use this when the user asks open-ended questions like 'which vendors failed to sync recently?' or 'show me pending vendors'. Sorted by createdon descending so the most recent activity appears first.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData $filter against the account entity. Pass crfe6_syncstatus eq 100000000 for Pending, 100000001 for Synced, 100000002 for Error.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Cap on number of rows returned. Defaults to 20 to keep agent responses readable.

200.description: A page of vendor rows matching the requested sync status.

accountid.description: Dataverse primary key for the Account row.

name.description: Vendor display name, mirrored from the Salesforce Account.Name field.

crfe6_uen.description: Singapore UEN (ACRA identifier), mirrored from the Salesforce UEN__c field.

crfe6_salesforceid.description: 18-character Salesforce Account ID. Alternate key for idempotent upsert.

crfe6_syncstatus.description: Option set: 100000000=Pending, 100000001=Synced, 100000002=Error. Stamped by the Azure Function: Synced on a successful upsert, Error on a failed attempt (best-effort, update-only).

crfe6_syncstatus@OData.Community.Display.description: Localized label of crfe6_syncstatus (e.g. 'Synced'). Always use this in agent responses to users.

crfe6_lastmodifiedbyintegration_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last integration-side write. Stamped by the Azure Function on every successful sync (and also by the AccountUpdateStampPlugin when that plugin is registered).

createdon.description: UTC timestamp of when the row was first created in Dataverse.

value.description: The requested page of vendor rows.

@odata.nextLink.description: Link to the next page of results if more rows match the filter. The agent should not follow this automatically — surface a summary count instead.
